description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModuleManager which manages HTML modules for the HTMLPurifier library, including registration, configuration, and retrieval of element definitions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModuleManager
classes.description: Manages the registration, setup, and retrieval of HTML modules and their element definitions within the HTMLPurifier framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the manager, registers basic doctypes, and sets up core modules.

methods.name: registerModule
methods.description: Registers a new module, possibly overloading existing ones.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a module to the current doctype, registering it if necessary.

methods.name: addPrefix
methods.description: Adds a class prefix for resolving module class names.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the manager based on a given configuration, processing modules and generating lookup tables.

methods.name: processModule
methods.description: Ensures a module is registered and included in the active module list.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Retrieves merged element definitions from all applicable modules.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves a merged definition for a specific element, merging relevant module definitions.
